messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — CRITICAL: runtime container crashloop detected in cluster 'prod-eu' pool-gamma on node gpu-07. CrashLoopBackOff x82, last exit reason SIGSEGV in /opt/runtime/fused_kernels.so

Maya (oncall): I'm on it. Can someone paste the last container logs and confirm blast radius?

Samir (eng-runtime): Logs from pod runtime-gamma-5fd7:
```
#0  0x7f2a9b3c in fused_attention_forward+0x1e4 (/opt/runtime/fused_kernels.so)
#1  0x7f2a9c00 in kv_cache_update+0x48
#2  0x55b2a1 in run_inference_loop
signal: SIGSEGV (address 0x0) reading from 0x0
allocated on GPU: 0x7fa3... mapped to nvmap id 12
```
Looks like a null pointer deref in the new fused attention path. Happened ~80x across pool-gamma in the last 7m.

Tasha (sre): node gpu-07 is flapping, kubelet restarted twice. kubelet logs show OOM-killer was invoked earlier but current failures are segfaults. Could be memory corruption after prior OOM.

Alex (platform): Recent deploy at 11:02 (image: runtime:2026-03-15-0f3a) included PR #4123 (quantized-fused-kernel rewrite). Canary passed but seems regressed at scale. Recommend immediate rollback to runtime:2026-03-14-9b7d.

Samir (eng-runtime): +1 rollback. Quick triage: the fused kernel assumes valid `kv_ptr` from CUDA allocator; if allocator returns null on pinned mapping failure we don't check. I can push a minimal guard in the kernel wrapper but that requires rebuild. Rolling back is faster.

Maya (oncall): Can we mitigate traffic while rolling back? What's customer impact?

Julie (support): Monitoring: errors spiking for 3 large tenants (alpha-data, beta-chat, gamma-search). 15-30% request error rate for those routes in last 10m. Pager triggered by internal SLO alarms. Tickets open: #INC-2321, #INC-2322, #INC-2323. Users seeing 500s and timeouts.

Dmitri (ml): We can temporarily route traffic to smaller model variants (cpu-backed or non-fused kernels) to reduce blast radius. That will increase latency/cost but avoid crashloops. Can routing be flipped quickly?

Alex (platform): Yes — we have a routing policy gate. Command to flip to fallback: ```kubectl -n inference patch configmap routing-policies -p '{"data":{"pool-gamma":"fallback-model:stable"}}'``` followed by `kubectl rollout restart deployment/proxy-gateway` to pick up routing change.

Tasha (sre): Plan: 1) Drain gpu-07 to stop further node flaps 2) Rollback runtime image on pool-gamma 3) Promote patched image to canary after tests 4) Route affected tenants to fallback models until stable. I'll start node drain.

Samir (eng-runtime): I'm building a hotfix branch that adds a null-check and a defensive fallback to CPU for that path. Will push image `runtime:hotfix-374000` shortly. Patch diff: ```
if (!kv_ptr) {
  LOG_WARN("kv_ptr null, falling back to cpu path");
  return cpu_attention(...);
}
``` This avoids segfaults but we need validation.

Maya (oncall): Tasha please own the rollback and traffic shift. Samir please prioritize the hotfix PR and CI. Alex coordinate image promotions. Julie keep customers updated. I'll start incident doc. Handoff to Tasha in 15m if still open.

incident-bot: Incident declared SEV2; start timer. Incident channel auto-created: #incident-3740004321.

Tasha (sre): Running: `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data node/gpu-07` to evacuate pods. Will cordon after.

Alex (platform): Rolling back pool-gamma daemonset to image runtime:2026-03-14-9b7d -> `kubectl -n inference set image ds/runtime-gamma runtime=runtime:2026-03-14-9b7d`

Samir (eng-runtime): Hotfix image pushed to registry as `runtime:hotfix-374000` and uploaded to canary tag. Can run smoke test: `/opt/runtime/bin/selftest --fused-kernel-check`.

Tasha (sre): Drain complete, cordoned gpu-07. Restarting ds with rollback image now. Pods are coming up, initial pods stable.

Julie (support): Customer update posted to status.redwood.ai: "We are experiencing elevated errors for embeddings and chat routes in EU region. We have mitigations in progress, temporary routing to fallback models and node-level rollback. No data loss. Updates every 15 minutes." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3740004321

Samir (eng-runtime): Canary smoke test passed on one host with hotfix image. But I still want to run the full integration test set before wide promotion. Patch reduces throughput slightly; recommend keeping routing fallback until we validate.

Dmitri (ml): Agreed. Routing to CPU/fallback cut error rate for alpha-data from 28% -> 3% in the test bucket. Latency up ~180ms avg but acceptable for now.

Maya (oncall): Handoff: I'm handing incident to Tasha (sre) for execution and monitoring. Summary: segfault in fused_kernels after recent quant-kernel deploy. Actions in flight: node evacuate, image rollback, routing fallback, hotfix built for canary. I'm reachable if needed.

Tasha (sre): Taking over. I'll keep the channel updated every 10m. Current status: rollback completed, affected tenants routed to fallback-models, error rate dropping but not fully recovered for beta-chat. Next: promote hotfix to staging then to prod canary if green.

Samir (eng-runtime): Creating PR #4150 hotfix; CI started. If green, request Alex for canary rollout.

Alex (platform): Canary rollout of `runtime:hotfix-374000` started on 2 nodes. Watching metrics.

incident-bot: Auto update: 10m elapsed. Estimated customer impact: 3 tenants partial, ~12% of EU inference capacity degraded.

Tasha (sre): Beta-chat still seeing ~6% errors on fallback routes; investigating if proxy timeouts also contributing. Restarted proxy-gateway to pick up routing config.

Julie (support): Sending milestone update to affected tenant contacts: short summary, what we're doing, ETA for next update ~15m.

Samir (eng-runtime): CI green, pushing request: `promote-image runtime:hotfix-374000 to canary-production`

Alex (platform): Promoted. New canary pods on pool-gamma are stable for 5m. Observability: fused_kernels segfaults count -> 0 on canary; overall errors falling.

Tasha (sre): Good. Rolling out hotfix to remaining nodes gradually with surge limit. Will keep routing fallback until rollout completes and 20m stable.

Maya (oncall): Thanks team. Action items recorded: Samir PR + postmortem owner, Tasha rollout and runbook update, Alex validate deploy gating, Julie customer comms.

Samir (eng-runtime): Postmortem owner: Samir. Drafting immediate RCA notes: root cause = missing allocator null check in quantized fused attention path introduced by PR #4123. Contributing factor = canary scale tests didn't exercise NVMap mapping failure path.

Tasha (sre): Closing loop: as of last check error rates for affected tenants dropped to 1-2%. Reverting routing fallback in 20m after stability window.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Duration so far: ~40m.

Julie (support): Final customer note draft ready for review. No escalations needed.

Maya (oncall): Marking handoff complete. I'll join postmortem review in 2h. Great job everyone. :white_check_mark:
